## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Firmware behavior
- [ ] Board support or pin mapping
- [ ] Display or UI
- [ ] Build, flashing or provisioning tooling
- [ ] Documentation or release assets
- [ ] Other

## Verification

- [ ] `pio run -e nesso_n1` succeeds.
- [ ] Tested on a physical Nesso N1.
- [ ] Tested with a second LoRa node or BLE host, if relevant.
- [ ] Not tested on hardware; explain why below.

Describe exactly what was tested, including firmware hash, radio configuration
and observed results.

## Documentation

- [ ] README verified/not-verified tables are updated if behavior changed.
- [ ] Checksums or release notes are updated if prebuilt binaries changed.
- [ ] No sensitive data, full flash dumps, credentials or personal paths are included.

## Additional context

Add logs, screenshots or anything else that helps review.
